overrides.01|1|So, where do I start?: Let me tell you a bit about myself.
overrides.01|1|I was born in 1989, in a small town: I was born in 1989 in a small town called Oizumi, in Gunma. It's about an hour and a half north of Tokyo.
overrides.01|2|I was a pretty quiet kid — nothing: I was a quiet kid. I spent most of my time playing video games and studying.
overrides.01|3|I went through elementary, middle,: I went to elementary school, junior high, and high school all in Gunma.
I never moved or changed schools.
overrides.01|4|I didn't join any club at school ei: I didn't join any club at school.
overrides.01|4|I was what we call a \"go-home club: I was basically a "go-home club" kid, but instead of going home, I went straight to the arcade.
overrides.01|5|I was really into fighting games ba: I was really into fighting games back then, mostly Marvel vs. Capcom 2 and King of Fighters.
It's a pretty niche hobby, I know.
overrides.01|6|One thing that shaped that whole pe: My health really shaped that part of my life.
overrides.01|6|I had this lung condition called pn: I had a lung condition called pneumothorax, and I had surgery seven times between junior high and high school. Some were keyhole surgery, some were open-chest.
overrides.01|6|I was in and out of the hospital al: I was in and out of the hospital all the time.
overrides.01|7|It's all healed up now, no follow-u: I'm completely healed now, no check-ups needed, but it was a big part of growing up.
overrides.01|8|For university, I went to Waseda Un: I went to Waseda University in Tokyo and studied resources and environmental engineering.
overrides.01|9|To be honest, though, I actually wa: I'd actually wanted to work in IT since high school.
overrides.01|9|My first choice was the industrial: My first choice was industrial and management systems, but I didn't get in, so I ended up in resources engineering.
overrides.01|10|I stayed on for a master's degree: I stayed for a master's degree and joined a lab focused on petroleum research.
overrides.01|10|My main project was rock failure t: My main project was rock failure testing — basically breaking rocks to measure how strong they are.
overrides.01|11|I built my own original testing ri: I built my own testing rig to get better data, and then used those numbers in simulations.
overrides.01|12|I also worked on this calibration: I also worked on a calibration method. We measured rock hardness every meter with a quick, simple tool, and then converted those values into proper strength numbers.
overrides.01|12|A single strength test takes over: A strength test takes over an hour per sample, but a hardness check only takes about a minute.
overrides.01|12|So instead of spending 100 hours t: So instead of 100 hours for 100 data points, we could do it in about 10 hours.
overrides.01|12|That was actually a really fun pro: It was a really fun project.
overrides.01|13|After my master's, I joined an oil: After my master's, I joined an oil and gas company. I'm still with the same company today.
overrides.01|13|My first assignment was on-site in: My first job was on-site in Akita, up in the north of Japan, just below Hokkaido.
overrides.01|14|I was doing well inspections — ope: I did well inspections — opening and closing valves to adjust oil output based on supply and demand. I also did sand production analysis, which means simulating how much you can produce before the rock around the well starts to break down.
I spent three years out there.
overrides.01|15|Then I transferred to the technica: Then I moved to the technical research center in Chiba, and I spent five years there.
overrides.01|15|I went deeper into sand production: I went deeper into sand production work — modeling real wells and running simulations to find the best production rate.
overrides.01|16|The work itself was solid, but som: The work was good, but during those years in Chiba, I started getting anxious about my future.
overrides.01|16|Like, am I really going to be an o: I kept asking myself if I really wanted to be an oil engineer for the rest of my career.
overrides.01|17|And honestly, since high school I': I'd wanted to work in IT since high school, and that feeling came back.
overrides.01|17|I started a side project building: I started a side project building social media automation tools, and that pulled me back into IT for real.
overrides.01|18|Eventually, I made an internal tra: Eventually I transferred internally to the IT department, which is now called the Digital Strategy Division.
overrides.01|18|These days I build automation tool: These days I build automation tools to make our work more efficient, and I'm leading the rollout of generative AI and AI agents across the company.
overrides.01|19|So all in all, I've been at this c: All in all, I've been at this company for 11 years now — three in Akita, five in Chiba, and the rest in the Digital Strategy Division.
overrides.01|20|If I had to put my philosophy into: If I had to sum up my philosophy in one line: I'm fully focused on making money the smart way.
overrides.01|20|The goal is to hit 100 million yen: My goal is to hit 100 million yen and build real wealth.
